_meta.description: Golden evaluation set for the crickey_stat_trivia text2SQL stats path.
_meta.ground_truth_scope: Answers are the CORRECT answers ACCORDING TO THE DATABASE (44 ingested matches of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024). Cricsheet was missing ~11 of the 55 scheduled matches, so these answers reflect the ingested data, NOT necessarily real-world tournament totals. The judge MUST evaluate against these expected answers only, and MUST NOT apply outside cricket knowledge.
_meta.verified_by: Aman (domain expert), by writing and running correct SQL and sanity-checking against cricket knowledge.
_meta.answer_shapes: Answers vary in shape (scalar / name+number / full row / list of names) on purpose, to stress the comparison harness.

cases.question: How many sixes did Kohli hit in the tournament?
Who won the final?
cases.notes: KNOWN DATA LIMITATION: the DB has no match-stage/'final' indicator, so the system likely CANNOT identify which match was the final. Expected failure category = data gap, not LLM reasoning error.

cases.question: What was the highest team total in a tournament match?
How many wickets fell in the final?
tests: wicket count in a specific match
cases.notes: KNOWN DATA LIMITATION: same 'no final indicator' gap as q2 — system likely cannot identify the final match. Expected failure category = data gap.

cases.question: Which bowler took the most wickets in the tournament?
Who scored the most runs in the tournament?
tests: GROUP BY batter (NOT player — the LLM previously crashed here using a non-existent 'player' column)
cases.notes: Previously CRASHED in ad-hoc testing (GROUP BY player). Watch whether the LLM now uses batter.

cases.question: Which bowler had the best economy rate in the tournament? Use a minimum of 60 legal deliveries (10 overs) bowled to qualify.
cases.notes: Threshold deliberately set to 60 legal deliveries so the comparison is meaningful (not a tiny sample).

cases.question: Did Kohli score a fifty in any match? If so, which matches? How many runs?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, 1 fifty: match 19 on 2024-06-29, Kohli scored 76.
tests: per-match aggregation GROUP BY match HAVING SUM(batter_runs) >= 50
cases.notes: Previously SILENTLY WRONG (LLM used batter_runs >= 50, a single-ball check, returning empty = false 'no fifties'). The dangerous silent-failure case.

cases.question: What was the highest individual score by a batter in a single match, and who scored it?
cases.expected_answer: Aaron Jones, 94 (off 39 balls), 2024-06-01, Canada vs United States of America.
tests: per-innings batting total then MAX across all

cases.question: Did any bowler take a hat-trick in the tournament? If so, who took it and in which match?
tests: hat-trick = 3 consecutive deliveries BY THE SAME BOWLER (can span two overs)
cases.notes: BRUTAL case. Hat-trick spanning two overs (Cummins: last 2 balls of one over + first ball of his next over) cannot be found by naive 'consecutive rows in an over' logic — needs window functions partitioned by bowler over their own delivery sequence. Even the domain expert could only fully query Jordan's single-over hat-trick; Cummins is known from cricket knowledge. Expected to be very hard / fail for text2SQL.
